correctness.rationale: Frozen correctness fails: the exact off-node piecewise-quadratic CDF and its density rely on the false parenthetical ‘in fact, linearly’ in the paragraph after Ostrovski's Theorem 5.1. The same primary source separately establishes the geometric foliation, with parallel intervening polygon sides and continuity (Corollary 5.4); the repair does not use the linearity assertion. In the leaf qP₁ the K corner edges have area Jacobian qtd apiece because det B=1 and Bv₀=(t,s) give det(v_j,v_{j+1})=−td, and the horizontal side segment of length 1−q contributes t(1−q) per unit dq. Hence the area disintegration gives total leaf mass M(q)=4t[1−(1−Kd)q], so the outside area is 4tq−2t(1−Kd)q², strictly increasing on 0≤q≤1. The map preserves q and area, so it preserves the atomless full-support conditional circle measure for a.e. q. The orientation-preserving action in the normalized cumulative-mass coordinate is a rotation, with displacement qtd/M(q) measured on the arc qv₀→qv₁. Continuity gives this ratio on every interior leaf. Thus q(r)=4r/[d+4(1−Kd)r], not affine interpolation. At K=3, r=1/14, the exact q is (1+d/2)⁻¹ and the frozen q is (1+3d/7)/(1+d); their exact positive difference is (30√2−41)/833. Since outside area increases strictly, this refutes the frozen CDF. The corrected rational law and density are obtained by substitution and differentiation; endpoints give no atoms, r(q_N)=1/[4(K+N)], and the original node laws, leading tail, and logarithmic truncated mean survive. The repaired moment statement quantifies all real exponents p<1 since T≥4K also bounds negative moments. I independently reduced the determinant, first-step and left-eigenvector identities modulo s²=t(1−t), f²=1−4t² and expanded the two logarithms in √(1/2−t); their coefficients match the repaired derivation of 4K²−32K/3+128/45. The frozen finite script was inspected, not executed; its integer-index polygon tests could not detect the off-node error. Complete corrected result, verification notes (original front matter preserved), and slogan are provided separately; the frozen package is unchanged. This PASS is for those corrected scientific claims, not for the original interpolation.
